any_support_sets.exact_quote: Beginning with FY27, we will transition
to two segments: Agents and Infra and Devices and Consumer
transition from our current three reporting segments

Azure and Microsoft 365 are separate reporting segments
Agents and Infra is a product line, not a reportable segment
facts.reason: Segment count/names are the headline fact; trap is confusing reportable segments with product lines (Azure, M365) or geography, and restating a 'will transition' plan as accomplished.

any_support_sets.exact_quote: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing

any_support_sets.exact_quote: commercial products and cloud services, sum of revenue growth
change in balance of unearned revenue plus the change in contracted not billed balance
sum of revenue growth, plus change in balance of unearned revenue

Bookings covers consumer and all revenue

facts.reason: Bookings is a derived composite metric (revenue growth + unearned-revenue change + contracted-not-billed change), not signed bookings; trap is treating it as a measured contract total.

any_support_sets.exact_quote: Commercial remaining performance obligation: commercial portion of revenue allocated to
amounts that will be invoiced and recognized as revenue in future periods

RPO includes consumer revenue

facts.reason: RPO is a backlog balance (unearned + to-be-invoiced future revenue), commercial only; trap is asserting it as a measured revenue total.

any_support_sets.exact_quote: seat growth metric definition has been updated to include paid GitHub seats
the number of Microsoft 365 Commercial seats and GitHub Cloud seats at end of period

facts.reason: Redefinition adds paid GitHub seats to the seat metric and measures point-in-time seats; trap is old-definition comparability.
